description: Real-model runs recorded once, locally, for the portfolio demo. Variants and evaluators listed here are added to the seeded example suites; runs reference variants and evaluators by name (new or seeded). Check model ids against each provider's current model list and backend/pricing.json before recording.

variants.name: GPT-5 mini · prompt v1
variants.system_prompt: You are a helpful research assistant. Answer the user's question.

variants.name: GPT-5 mini · prompt v2
variants.system_prompt: You are a research assistant. Answer using only the context provided. Be concise. Cite the passage you relied on as [n].

variants.name: Claude Haiku 4.5 · prompt v2
variants.system_prompt: You are a research assistant. Answer using only the context provided. Be concise. Cite the passage you relied on as [n].

config.criteria: Does the response state the same facts as the reference answer? Penalise missing, incorrect, or conflicting figures, dates, and names. Extra correct detail is fine.
Is every claim in the response supported by the provided context? Penalise speculation, outside knowledge, and hallucinated details, even when they sound plausible.

variants.name: GPT-5 mini · free-form
variants.system_prompt: Extract the company name, annual revenue, and fiscal year from the document as JSON.

variants.name: GPT-5 mini · strict JSON
variants.system_prompt: Return only JSON with exactly these keys: company (string), revenue (integer, the full number in USD), year (integer fiscal year). No prose, no markdown.

variants.name: Claude Haiku 4.5 · strict JSON
variants.system_prompt: Return only JSON with exactly these keys: company (string), revenue (integer, the full number in USD), year (integer fiscal year). No prose, no markdown.
